title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: In linear algebra, two vectors are orthogonal if their dot product is zero. This means they are perpendicular to each other in the vector space.

title: Residuals in OLS
text: The residuals in an OLS model, represented by Y-\hat{Y}, are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. These residuals have a special relationship with the design matrix X.

title: Properties of Residuals
text: In an OLS model, the residuals are orthogonal to the columns of the design matrix X. This is a key property that ensures the best fit line minimizes the sum of squared residuals.
